recognitionRules: Use large numbered stage labels and separate evidence slips.
Pair Avenir display labels with Noto Sans working text.
Keep one prompt or observation per movable unit.
Distinguish an observed record from an idea or a chosen test through explicit headings.
Use the source row of outlined prompt shapes with amber, sage and warm-paper fills; keep burgundy stage labels and black working text distinct.

invariants: Use large numbered stage labels and separate evidence slips.
